must: register every evidence-bearing source before substantive reliance
preserve or identify the native source and fingerprint it when available
declare searchable-text, visual-evidence and redaction states
carry exact provenance, variant and open-gap information into the handoff
must_not: call a text-only rendition visually complete
invent or synthesize an evidence image
silently conflate same-named binaries with different hashes

must: reconcile variants and preserve all unique source content
ensure the original/text/image triad survives integration
render source-derived full-page images when the native source is available
keep restricted originals out of public Git while preserving custody references
add actor, entity, proceeding, event and page links
must_not: drop open visual or OCR gaps during merge
replace native custody with a public derivative

must: validate paths, hashes, page order, OCR linkage and redaction safety
confirm that public images derive from the public derivative
perform route and asset readback before LIVE_VERIFIED
report partial and blocked states truthfully
must_not: infer completeness from deployment success alone

must: authorize the publication boundary and public derivative
present source images with searchable text and provenance
record deployed commit and independent live verification
preserve allegation, counter-evidence and legal-effect boundaries
must_not: publish private data merely to satisfy visual completeness
claim exact filing identity without supporting evidence

must: carry the structured evidence-visibility register into the next thread or workspace
preserve every unresolved source, image, OCR, translation, provenance and redaction gap
name the next owner role and action
prevent deletion while unique evidence state remains unregistered
must_not: erase pending states because a public summary exists

publication_invariants: Searchable text does not replace source-derived visual evidence.
Visual evidence does not replace searchable text.
A redacted public derivative does not replace preservation of the native source.
No synthetic or reconstructed visual may be labelled as evidence.
A package is not visually complete while any in-scope record is pending, partial or blocked.

priority_order: current judicial filings, orders, notifications and receipts
deeds, registry records and decisive documentary anchors
emails and messages central to knowledge, notice, instruction or chronology
records already cited on public pages
